claims.claim: TOI-2535 b orbits its star every 8.25 days and is located about 1,000 light-years away.
claims.episode_span: TOI-2535 b, a hot Jupiter orbiting its star every 8.25 days, stopped transiting after its orbit tilted.
claims.source_title: First known 'disappearing planet' has a neighbor that makes it wobble like a top
claims.supporting_quote: TOI-2535 b whips around its star in only 8.25 days—10 times faster than the 88 days that Mercury takes to go around our sun once.

claims.claim: Subaru Telescope observations showed Comet Encke’s nucleus has a long axis of about 7 km and short axis of about 3 km, with a surface temperature of 328 ± 7 Kelvin.
claims.episode_span: Mid-infrared observations showed the nucleus is elongated, with a long axis of about 7 km and a short axis of about 3 km. At the time of observation the surface temperature reached 328 ± 7 Kelvin.
claims.source_title: Subaru Telescope reveals the shape and temperature of Comet Encke's nucleus
claims.supporting_quote: By analyzing how the nucleus's thermal emission changed as it rotated, the researchers found that the nucleus is elongated, with a long axis of about 7 kilometers and a short axis of about 3 kilometers. They also determined that the surface temperature at the time of observation was 328 ± 7 Kelvin (about 55°C).

claims.claim: Chandra data showed AT 2016blu at least 100 times brighter in X-rays than in 2001-2002 observations.
claims.episode_span: NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory detected X-ray emission from AT 2016blu that is at least 100 times brighter than earlier observations.
claims.source_title: NASA’s Chandra Finds Source of Star’s Mysterious Outbursts
claims.supporting_quote: Chandra data from March 2026 revealed that AT 2016blu was at least 100 times brighter in X-rays than in Chandra data from 2001 to 2002, which is before the outbursts began.
